name: 360° Twist Rotatable Triangle Mop with Long Handle Auto Squeeze Design for Floor, Wall, and Ceiling Cleaning
description:
Make cleaning effortless with the 360° Twist Rotatable Mop. Featuring a triangular mop head and 360° rotation, it reaches tight corners, walls, ceilings, and windows with ease. Equipped with a thickened microfiber mop cloth, it quickly absorbs water and locks in dust. The built-in push-pull squeeze function mimics hand washing, keeping your hands free from dirt while ensuring quick drying and storage.Key Features:
 Rotatable triangular mop head for corner and edge cleaning
 Adjustable long handle for high or low areas
 Thickened microfiber mop cloth with superior absorption
 Automatic push-pull squeeze function for hands-free cleaning
 Durable stainless steel and PP material construction
 Works on multiple surfaces: tile, wood, laminate, vinyl, walls, and ceilingsHow to Use:
 Extend the handle to desired length
 Attach microfiber cloth to mop head securely
 Use dry for dusting or wet for floor and wall cleaning
 Push-pull for automatic squeeze wringing
 Store vertically in a corner after use for quick dryingSafety Information:
 Avoid using on hot surfaces or near flames
 Ensure handle sections are securely locked before use
 Keep out of reach of children when extended

Package Includes:
 1 × 360° Twist Rotatable Mop (Extended Section) with Microfiber Mop Cloth
